# MedCalc-Bench Verified (v1.0.8) with labels regenerated by the fixed calculator code

Inputs: dataset/{test,train,one_shot}_verified.csv (Hugging Face nsk7153/MedCalc-Bench-Verified v1.0.8).
Code: medcalc_verified_code, branch fix/anion-gap-and-sofa, commit 810287c.
Command: python3 equation_audit/run_generate_csv.py dataset/<split>_verified.csv dataset/verified_regenerated/<split>_verified_regenerated.csv

Only answers, limits and explanations are recomputed; notes, questions and Relevant Entities are unchanged.
Every changed cell is listed in label_changes.csv.

| Split | Answers changed | Explanations only |
|---|---|---|
| test (1,100) | 0 | 6 SOFA (cut-off explanation or renal wording) |
| train (10,538) | 32 HOMA-IR (insulin in pmol/L was multiplied by 6 instead of divided: values 36x too high) | 75 SOFA, 11 PSI (wording) |
| one-shot (55) | 0 | 0 |

Errors in the extracted inputs themselves are not fixed here: labels follow the entities.
